svg.text: Functional capabilities, sub-features and component relationships across the application
Parses raw administrative documents into verified database records
Converts tabular PDFs to structured JSON.

Displays physical campus location of faculty.
Admin updates cabin, designation and email inline.
Enterprise operations, telemetry logging and agent protocol
14 tools exposed via Model Context Protocol.
Recovers dangling jobs interrupted by reboots.
